extraction_quality.review_notes: Planning/BMP guidance appendix for EBR Master Development Program (July 2007). Explicitly requires calculating pre-development runoff for a minimum ten-year design storm, but does not define a quantified water quality volume, named hydrologic method (e.g., Rational/TR-55), or required software.
